messages.subject: withMathJax inline equations font-size
parts:
I'm trying to render some inline math in paragraph line. The MathJax font appears much too small. I've tried messing with the style in a span argument, but no avail. How do I make the font bigger?

Example:
p("Here is some text and now an equation: \\( (i-1)/n \\)")
